# THE COHERENCE GLYPH

*What AURA shows a person, and why it is a figure rather than a number. A working summary, written to be understood in one reading by a person or by a machine.*

---

## I · THE PROBLEM IT SOLVES

AURA registers two things about someone: whether a real human is there, and
what that human has actually done. It keeps them as separate axes and never
adds them together. Personhood is a confidence between zero and one, built from
vouches and witnessed acts between humans, and it decays without
re-attestation. Standing is act-derived, accumulated from the receipt chain. A
thousand receipts with no personhood is nothing; a verified human with two
receipts is still somebody.

Both need to be legible to a community, and neither can be published as a
score. Any measure of a quality, once visible, is optimised for instead of
achieved: a number on care produces the performance of care. So AURA has a
display problem. How is something real shown without being ranked?

## II · THE MOVE

**Draw it. Do not count it.**

The architecture is three layers, and the separation is the whole design:

| layer | what lives there |
|---|---|
| **stored** | traces. Receipts of what actually happened. |
| **read by machines** | predicates and orderings. Booleans and comparisons; numbers exist only transiently, inside a computation. |
| **shown to people** | a figure. The coherence glyph, and nothing else. |

A figure can be recognised without being ranked. That is the entire reason it
exists.

## III · WHAT THE GLYPH IS

A pattern generated from a spectrum, rendered as a standing wave.

- **Deterministic from a stable signature**, so one person always draws the
  same family of figures. Recognisable across time.
- **Computed from current activity, never stored.** It exists while the
  activity does and fades when that stops. There is no aggregate held anywhere,
  because a held aggregate persists whether or not the person does.
- **Capped in detail.** Precision beyond the underlying signal describes
  nothing, and fine precision invites exactly the ranking the design forbids.
- **Never accompanied by a number**, at any level, for anyone.

It is a voice rather than a fingerprint. Recognisable, and moving with the
person's state. This is a deliberate limit, not modesty: a shape's spectrum
does not uniquely determine the shape, since distinct drums with identical
spectra were constructed in 1992. So the glyph is recognisable and is never a
proof. **No figure demonstrates that a human is present.**

**The two axes stay two.** Personhood and standing are never summed anywhere
else, so they may not be blended into a single input here. They must reach the
figure as independent properties. As built, the instrument accepts one coherence
value, which is a gap between the display and the economics, and it is named
here so it is not forgotten.

## IV · HOW IT READS

Two ways to fail, and health is the band between them.

**Scatter.** Structure lost, the figure breaks into noise, nothing reads.

**Lock.** The figure hardens into a rigid repeating form that no longer answers
to change. Over-accumulation looks like this, not like success.

The ratio of what a person gives to what they draw is the tuning between those
two states. It is a parameter of the instrument, never a virtue and never a
verdict. Someone drawing far more than they return becomes visible in the shape
of their figure, and is never named in a judgement.

## V · ONE, TWO, AND MANY

**One.** The figure as described above.

**Two.** Laid together, shared structure reinforces and difference visibly
disagrees. The disagreement is the measurement, not a fault in the rendering.

**Many.** A different kind of object, not a larger version of the first.

**The group figure is never an average.** Averaging fails on three grounds,
each checkable without any theory: the result matches no actual member; the
information about disagreement is destroyed and unrecoverable; and a single
derived value becomes the authoritative description of the group, which then
governs it. Build the group figure instead from structure the members
demonstrably share, established between pairs and promoted only where it holds
across the set. Nothing is voted on and nothing is smoothed.

**The residual is displayed.** A set of people can be compatible in every pair
and still admit no arrangement consistent with all of them at once. That
inconsistency is conserved and does not shrink by going unrecorded, so it is
rendered as unresolved movement at the edge of the group figure. A summary that
hides its own inconsistency has not resolved it. It has passed the cost to
whoever relies on the summary later, who will have no way of knowing it was
there.

## VI · THE REFUSALS

Each stated so it can be tested.

1. No number is shown to anyone, at any scale. A group has no score exactly as
   a person has none.
2. No aggregate is stored. The figure is recomputed from current activity.
3. Nothing raises the figure except participation itself.
4. The figure informs and authorises nothing. No process depends on it. AURA
   weights the society; only the AUMLOK signature gates the machine.
5. Detail stays capped.
6. Imbalance shows as shape, never as a published judgement.
7. Coordinated inactivity is a valid state, shown as rest and distinguishable
   from abandonment.
8. The residual is never removed to improve the figure's appearance.
9. No figure is ever called proof of a human.

## VII · WHAT IS BUILT, AND WHAT IS NEXT

Built, in `spatial/app/coherence-glyph.js`, on a plain canvas so it runs on any
device: a deterministic spectrum from a signature, the superposed standing wave
rendered with its still lines in metal and its flow in light, a coherence input
that modulates clarity rather than size, and a figure that breathes rather than
freezing. Two spectra can be weighed and combined. Progression makes more of a
person's existing modes legible without the figure growing larger.

The signature, as built, is a local device identifier and the coherence value is a
provisional local stand-in, badged as such. The witnessed version stays the
chain's to speak.

Next, in order: extend the renderer from one spectrum to a set; derive the
shared structure at the overlaps without averaging; derive and render the
residual; bind throughput so the figure dims without circulation; then pin all
of it, including that the residual is never zero by construction, that the
render never reduces to a scalar, and that a group of one returns exactly the
figure as it stands. The two-axis gap named in section III is resolved before
any of this ships.

## VIII · WHAT THIS DOES NOT REST ON

Recorded so that no reader re-imports the scaffolding as though it were load
bearing. The reasoning that produced this design leaned on the stable metals
and the icosahedron, on the geometric break between the countable and the
continuous, on the golden ratio as an identity constant, and on a
thousand-year terraced watershed governed without a centre. All of it is true,
much of it is beautiful, and the design was reached through it.

None of it is holding the design up. Every claim above stands on plain ground:
measures become targets, stored values outlive the thing they measured,
averages destroy disagreement, and hidden inconsistency travels downstream. The
full reasoning is preserved in this file's history for anyone who wants the
path rather than the result.
